class student_Type:
    # Function Objective: Compute the GPAX of one student
    # Input parameters : f_point_total (float) weighted grade points, creditTotal (float) registered credits
    # Function description: Divide the weighted grade points by the registered credits, capped at the maximum GPAX
    # Return Value : float GPAX value
    # Created By : Programmer A
    # Create Date: 2026-09-28
    # Revised By:
    # Revised Date:
    def f_Calculate_Gpax(self, f_point_total, creditTotal):
        MAX_GPAX = 4.0
        f_gpax = 0.0
        # check that credits were registered
        if creditTotal > 0:
            f_gpax = f_point_total / creditTotal
        # else no credit registered, keep GPAX at zero
        else:
            f_gpax = 0.0
        return min(f_gpax, MAX_GPAX)
